HEXAGHOST-IGNITE.title: Ignite
HEXAGHOST-IGNITE.description: Triggers the Ignition effect described on a Ghostflame.
HEXAGHOST-WHEEL.title: Ghostflame Wheel
HEXAGHOST-WHEEL.description: Holds 6 Ghostflames. The top Ghostflame is active. Fulfilling its condition [gold]Ignites[/gold] it. At end of turn, if the active Ghostflame is [gold]Ignited[/gold], [gold]Advance[/gold].
HEXAGHOST-EXTINGUISH.title: Extinguish
HEXAGHOST-EXTINGUISH.description: Resets an [gold]Ignited[/gold] Ghostflame so it can be [gold]Ignited[/gold] again.
